Each concept has one line that's always shown and a deeper paragraph one tap away, by generation where the rules differ. Written against the engine's own formulas (trainers/era.py, battle/evaluate.py) and E-038; class: mechanic.

line.3: Up to 252 in one stat and 510 in all; every 4 EVs is one stat point at level 100.
line.4: Up to 252 in one stat and 510 in all; every 4 EVs is one stat point at level 100.
line.2: Gen II has stat experience instead: every stat can be maxed, with no total.

more.3: EVs come from the Pokémon it defeats (and vitamins and items). The formula adds a quarter of a stat's EVs before the level scales it, so at level 100 four EVs make one point and at level 50 eight do. The game lets a stat hold 255, but only 252 count; with 510 in all, two full stats leave 6, and only 4 of those count. The app reads a blank spread as none recorded: fights use the standard 85 in every stat (D-061) and it counts as no evidence for any role (B19).

more.2: Gen II's stat experience goes up to 65,535 in each stat, and the formula adds a quarter of its square root, so a maxed stat gains the same as 252 EVs later. The app uses Showdown's scale, where 252 is the max. Special Attack and Special Defense share one Special value, and there's no total cap.

line.3: 0-31 in each stat, fixed at birth; at level 100 each IV point is one stat point.
line.4: 0-31 in each stat, fixed at birth; at level 100 each IV point is one stat point.
line.2: Gen II has DVs, 0-15: HP's comes from the others, and they also decide gender and shininess.

more.3: Each IV is added straight into the formula, so 31 against 0 is 31 points at level 100. Hidden Power's type and power come from the IVs too. Breeding passes some of them down.
more.4: Each IV is added straight into the formula, so 31 against 0 is 31 points at level 100. Hidden Power's type and power come from the IVs too. Breeding passes some of them down.
more.2: A DV is half an IV (the app reads them the way Showdown does). The HP DV is built from the odd or even Attack, Defense, Speed and Special DVs; Special Attack and Special Defense share one Special DV. The Attack DV decides gender against the species' ratio, and shininess is a DV pattern: Defense, Speed and Special all 10, with one of eight Attack values (E-017, E-038).

line.3: Raises one stat by 10% and lowers another by 10%; five natures change nothing. HP is never touched.
line.4: Raises one stat by 10% and lowers another by 10%; five natures change nothing. HP is never touched.

more.3: The 10% is applied last and rounded down, so it's worth more on a higher stat. A nature that lowers a stat the build never uses (Special Attack on a physical attacker) costs nothing in battle.
